sections.heading: Job Description
sections.content: We are looking for Engineers with experience designing and building cloud solutions to work with us and our enterprise customers to plan, adopt and operate their infrastructure utilizing Amazon and Azure Web Services.  The ideal candidate will be able to participate in the planning, presentation and delivery of new or existing Cloud Operations.  Most of our customers are medium to large enterprises with existing on-prem solutions and have on-going or new Cloud efforts that include Migration and Hybrid solutions.

sections.heading: Required Qualifications
sections.content:
B.S. level technical degree or related experience
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Strong organizational, planning, and analytical skills
Highly collaborative and team oriented
Ability to keep to production schedules and work effectively with colleagues
Hands-on practitioner
Experience with integration of AWS services to on-premises infrastructure
Understanding of networking protocols and network topology
Understanding of hypervisor/virtualization
Experience with Linux and Windows administration
Experience with CI/CD Pipelines
2-3 years’ experience with Python/JavaScript
2-3 years’ experience with Terraform and/or Cloud Formation
3+ years’ experience with AWS (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, EFS, etc)
2+ years experience with AWS Control Tower
Experience with AWS CLI, AWS SAM and AWS SDK

sections.heading: Desired Qualifications
sections.content:
Experience with Azure Cloud technologies
Experience with AWS Landing Zone
Experience with enterprise systems and their deployment
Experience assessing, optimizing, automating IT service processes
Experience as full-stack developer
